say:2:1230505001:0.text: Everything's fine, of course, it's just all so sudden...
say:2:1230505001:0.source_cn: 当然没什么问题，只是这一切有些突然……
say:2:1230505001:0.male: Everything's fine, of course, it's just all so sudden...
say:2:1230505001:0.female: Everything's fine, of course, it's just all so sudden...

say:3:1230505002:0.text: Yeah, we've had so many run-ins with that flock of posy parrots... I mean, the Carmine Whispers.
say:3:1230505002:0.source_cn: 是啊，我们之前不是和那群粉毛鹦鹉……呃，和血薇帮他们起...
say:3:1230505002:0.male: Yeah, we've had so many run-ins with that flock of posy parrots... I mean, the Carmine Whispers.
say:3:1230505002:0.female: Yeah, we've had so many run-ins with that flock of posy parrots... I mean, the Carmine Whispers.

say:4:1230505003:1.text: They say we can do business in Rustport and they'll turn a blind eye... but who knows? What if they stab us in the back?
say:4:1230505003:1.source_cn: 虽然他们说以后我们在锈锚港做生意，他们可以睁一只眼闭一...
say:4:1230505003:1.male: They say we can do business in Rustport and they'll turn a blind eye... but who knows? What if they stab us in the back?
say:4:1230505003:1.female: They say we can do business in Rustport and they'll turn a blind eye... but who knows? What if they stab us in the back?

say:5:1230505004:0.text: Can't fully trust 'em, can't write 'em off. Guess we just have to stay sharp.
say:5:1230505004:0.source_cn: 不能全信，也不能不信。总之，我们得提高警惕……
say:5:1230505004:0.male: Can't fully trust 'em, can't write 'em off. Guess we just have to stay sharp.
say:5:1230505004:0.female: Can't fully trust 'em, can't write 'em off. Guess we just have to stay sharp.
